fields.title: SERCOP procurement process record
fields.description: One record per Ecuador SERCOP procurement process, produced by mode=list (a page of search_ocds results, optionally enriched with full detail) or mode=detail (one specific OCID's full OCDS release history). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a record can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:year=<year>:search=<query>'. For detail records: the OCID that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-search-ocds, S1-record-ocds, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_detailError.title: Detail enrichment error
_detailError.description: Present only on a list-mode row when fetchDetail=true and that row's own detail fetch failed -- the rest of the row's list fields are still valid.

id.title: Internal ID
id.description: SERCOP's own internal database row ID (list rows only).

ocid.title: OCID
ocid.description: The Open Contracting ID -- SERCOP's stable identifier for this procurement process across its whole planning -> tender -> award -> contract lifecycle.

date.title: Date
date.description: The process's publish date, as shown in search results (list rows only).

buyerId.title: Buyer ID
buyerId.description: The purchasing government institution's identifier (typically an RUC-based OCDS party id).

title.title: Title
title.description: The process's title/reference code as published in search results (list rows only).

description.title: Description
description.description: The process's free-text description (list rows only).

year.title: Year
year.description: The procurement process year (list rows only).

internalType.title: Procurement modality
internalType.description: SERCOP's Spanish-language procurement modality/type, e.g. 'Licitacion', 'Subasta Inversa Electronica' (list rows only).

singleProvider.title: Single provider
singleProvider.description: Named contractor already known at publish time, populated only for direct-award-style processes (list rows only).

tenderId.title: Tender ID
tenderId.description: The buyer's own tender reference number (detail, or list rows with fetchDetail=true).

budgetAmount.title: Budget amount
budgetAmount.description: The planning-stage budget amount, when present.

budgetCurrency.title: Budget currency
budgetCurrency.description: Currency code for budgetAmount, e.g. USD (Ecuador's official currency).

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Union of OCDS release tags seen across this record's release history (e.g. ['planning', 'tender', 'award']).

awardsCount.title: Awards count
awardsCount.description: Number of award entries across this record's release history.

contractsCount.title: Contracts count
contractsCount.description: Number of contract entries across this record's release history.

totalAwardAmount.title: Total award amount
totalAwardAmount.description: Sum of all award value amounts on this record, when present.

awardCurrency.title: Award currency
awardCurrency.description: Currency code for totalAwardAmount, e.g. USD.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Names of all winning suppliers across this record's awards.

latestReleaseDate.title: Latest release date
latestReleaseDate.description: The date of the most recent entry in this record's release history.

releases.title: Release history (full detail)
releases.description: The complete upstream OCDS 'releases' array verbatim, one entry per planning/tender/award/contract/implementation event -- present on detail records and list rows fetched with fetchDetail=true.

uri.title: Record URI
uri.description: Upstream OCDS release package URI, verbatim.

version.title: OCDS version
version.description: The OCDS schema version this release package conforms to (e.g. '1.1').

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: The OCDS publisher block (uid, name, scheme) -- 'Servicio Nacional de Contratacion Publica (SERCOP)' / 'ocds-5wno2w'.

extensions.title: OCDS extensions
extensions.description: URLs of the official OCDS extensions this release package uses (e.g. enquiries, lots, techniques, auctions, value breakdown).

publishedDate.title: Package published date
publishedDate.description: The release package's own publishedDate field, upstream.

license.title: License URL
license.description: Upstream OCDS license URL (Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Ecuador).

publicationPolicy.title: Publication policy URL
publicationPolicy.description: Upstream OCDS publication policy document URL.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
